addressed.claim_id: Fix remainder ordering to include weight tie-break (-remainder, -weight, index)
Replace rounded Decimal division with exact rational arithmetic using Fraction to compute floors and remainders

Replaced numeric check amount != amount.quantize(_CENT) with representation scale check amount.as_tuple().exponent < -2 so strings like "10.000" / "1.000" correctly raise ValueError and no InvalidOperation escapes; wrapped in try/except to map any exception to ValueError.
